state_space: 8 relative-position octants x 4 distance bins x 2 closed-or-grasped modes x 5 observable option contexts; align residual grid includes an observable dominant-error-axis bit; residual grid uses 10 bins per axis; fixed-action options bypass DLPFC/BG/PM and do not receive SNN plasticity; StrD1/StrD2 use one population LIF channel per action
communication: DLPFC-to-StrD1/StrD2 nonnegative NMF latent transport, rank 3 with repeat-vector delta/sample-and-hold and 12-bit fixed-scale quantization; all downstream BG links use full communication

simple_hardware_link_proxy.scope: DLPFC-to-StrD1/StrD2 only; downstream BG links remain full communication

assumptions.full_baseline: one one-hot DLPFC event multicast to both Str targets
assumptions.latent_frame: one paired D1+D2 vector update when both paths update in a slot
assumptions.link_service: one <=64-bit record per internal SNN slot
assumptions.fifo: arrival before service; no serialization, arbitration, retries, or physical timing modeled

rram_mvm_proxy.unit: array activation / input-row-drive proxy, not energy

simple_hardware_link_proxy.interpretation_limit: This proxy does not establish physical energy or latency savings. In particular, without repeat-delta a rank-3 vector frame is wider than a one-hot multicast AER frame.
